summary: Verified 'Our Work' header dropdown on /about. Dropdown shows EXACTLY 4 top-level items (Rakhigarhi, Theatre, Craft & Livelihood, Workshops & Learning), no nested sub-items, menu class is 'dropdown ' (NO 'mega' class). Each item is a working link to the expected /our-work/* path. Regression: all four child pages and /our-work return 200.
critical_code_review_comments: Dropdown toggle open state is fragile in headless: the document pointerdown listener fires on the same click that opens the menu (via setOpen toggle). In Playwright real .click() the menu is immediately closed; it only reliably opens via JS .click() dispatch. Consider using onPointerDown with stopPropagation on the toggle button, or ignoring pointerdown when target is inside ref. Not a user-facing bug in real browsers but worth hardening.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To open the Our Work dropdown in headless Chromium, use page.evaluate("document.querySelector('[data-testid=nav-m-work-toggle]').click()") instead of page.click(); pointerdown-close handler races with real clicks. Verified menu structure: 4 direct <li>, 0 nested <ul>, class is 'dropdown ' (not mega).
